{{Quote|And when spies brought me rumors of two strange, deadly ''gems'' in the Red Nebula&hellip; I rushed to investigate.|Domina Tagge|<ref name="SW50" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Domina Tagge/Legends|Domina Tagge]] organized a '''mission''' to the [[Red Nebula/Legends|Red Nebula]] in order to capture the [[Great Life Jewels]].

==Mission to the Red Nebula==
{{Quote|As our ship laid waste to the primitive civilization there, driving off some giant creature&hellip; this elite group of ''bounty hunters'' I'd hired captured the jewels and the priest tending them.|Domina Tagge|<ref name="SW50" />}}
The mission was orchestrated by [[Domina Tagge/Legends|Domina Tagge]], whose [[Spy/Legends|spies]] had learned of the [[Great Life Jewels]] which were located on a [[Planet of the Red Nebula|planet]] in the [[Red Nebula/Legends|Red Nebula]].<ref name="SW50" />

Tagge hired several [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] for the mission, including [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]], [[IG-88C/Legends|IG-88C]], [[IG-88D/Legends|IG-88D]], and [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]].<ref name="SW50" /><ref name="TNEGtC" />

There, her [[Mining Explorer]] bombarded the [[Untouched Valley]], laying waste to its [[Unidentified Red Nebula species|inhabitants]] and driving off the [[Red Nebula temple guardian|creature]] that guarded the [[Red Nebula temple|temple]] housing the gems. Meanwhile, the elite group of bounty hunters captured the jewels and the [[Unidentified priest (Red Nebula)|priest]] tending them.<ref name="SW50" />

==Firefight aboard the Mining Explorer==
{{Quote|We found an ''Imperial cruiser'' waiting just outside the nebula! ''Darth Vader'' had learned of my journey and dispatched a warship to discover the ''secret'' behind it. With our ''drive engines'' destroyed, I agreed to ''surrender'' our find.|Domina Tagge|<ref name="SW50" />}}
[[File:Firefight_aboard_the_Mining_Explorer.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] provoked a [[Lightfight|firefight]] with the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] aboard the [[Mining Explorer]]]]
Shortly after the theft, Tagge [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] the priest to force him to share his knowledge of the gems' deadly powers and learned that if they were separated, the gems would create the [[Crimson Forever]]. However, as they were leaving the Red Nebula, the Mining Explorer was attacked by an [[Unidentified Imperial-class Star Destroyer (Crimson Forever)|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] dispatched by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], whom had learned of Tagge's journey and wanted to discover the secret behind it.<ref name="SW50" />

The [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] destroyed the Mining Explorer's drive [[Engine/Legends|engines]], forcing Tagge to surrender her find. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] boarding party received only one of the two gems, placed by Tagge in a [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] cannister rigged to open under the pressures of [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]. Tagge also gave the Imperials the location of the new [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Golrath Station|base]] on [[Golrath/Legends|Golrath]] learned from her spies. Tagge then orchestrated a [[Lightfight|firefight]] between the bounty hunters and the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], which forced the boarders to leave the Mining Explorer, effectively separating the two Great Life Jewels.<ref name="SW50" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|What I ''didn't'' intend was that a dying ''priest'', momentarily unguarded during the fight, would reach and unleash the ''second'' jewel!|Domina Tagge|<ref name="SW50" />}}
[[File:Dying_priest.jpg|thumb|right|215px|The dying [[Unidentified priest (Red Nebula)|priest]] released the second [[Great Life Jewels|jewel]] from its [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] cannister]]
Following the firefight, the Imperials abandoned the damaged Mining Explorer on the fringes of the Red Nebula. The Star Destroyer set a course for Golrath and jumped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. As a result, the carbonite cannister holding the gem opened and the Crimson Forever spread aboard the [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. When the Star Destroyer arrived in the [[Golrath system/Legends|Golrath system]], the entire crew had succumbed from the effects of the plague.<ref name="SW50" />

Tagge's plan proceeded as she had intended. However, she did not anticipate that the dying priest would also release the second jewel still in her possession, thus spreading the Crimson Forever in the Mining Explorer. Tagge and the bounty hunters found themselves trapped in a section of the Mining Explorer uninfected by the Crimson Forever.<ref name="SW50" />

Some time later, the Rebels found the empty Star Destroyer in the Golrath system and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] became infected with the plague. Fortunately, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] had previously encountered such red jewels during a previous [[Attack on the Red Nebula temple|misadventure]] in the Red Nebula. After hearing the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee's]] tale of the event, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and Chewbacca decided to travel to the Red Nebula aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] in hopes of finding a cure for the Crimson Forever. On their way to the Red Nebula, they encountered the derelict Mining Explorer. After a [[Skirmish aboard the Mining Explorer|short fight]], they agreed to free Tagge and her companions in order to reunite the two Great Life Jewels and end the Crimson Forever.<ref name="SW50" />
